reason: A DSH plugin that monitors Volcengine Ark Coding Plan or Agent Plan quota through an authenticated API and displays usage and remaining amounts in a sidebar widget.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏显示火山方舟 Coding Plan 或 Agent Plan 的订阅额度使用与剩余情况。
summaries.en: Displays Volcengine Ark Coding Plan or Agent Plan subscription usage and remaining quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

capabilities: Reads Volcengine AccessKey ID and Secret Access Key configuration
Signs authenticated Volcengine control-plane API requests
Makes outbound requests to retrieve subscription quota data
Serves localhost HTTP routes for quota retrieval and credential updates
Stores credentials in the DSH settings or patch configuration
Displays quota usage and remaining amounts in a sidebar widget
